## Request and scope

What owner request or roadmap item does this implement?

## Changes

Include affected PHP routes/modules, schema/configuration, assets and user-visible behavior. Separate planned work from implemented work.

## Verification

Record exact commands/procedures, environment, results and limitations. Identify mocked/offline checks separately from native MySQL/GD/SMTP/HTTPS or target-host tests. Attach actual implementation screenshots where relevant, not concept art.

## Data preservation and deployment

Explain compatibility, migrations, protected config/storage/media, package layout, rollback/recovery and whether anything was actually deployed.

## Required documentation

- [ ] `PROJECT_STATUS.md` updated.
- [ ] `SESSION_HANDOFF.md` gives the next exact action.
- [ ] Dated entry appended to `docs/SESSION_LOG.md`.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and affected roadmap items updated.
- [ ] Direction/decision/architecture/brand/deployment notes updated where relevant.
- [ ] No secrets, client records or private config committed.
- [ ] No unsupported competitor, client, results or deployment claims.
- [ ] Approved logo/favicon and one-page/no-key installer requirements preserved.
- [ ] For release changes: canonical installer/dependency hashes, flat complete package, version labels and final artifact tested; otherwise explicitly not applicable.
